task: In bedtime mode only: let the last story page stand alone as a quiet moment (no auto-advance, narration ends softly), and make the ending leaf calm: no celebration animation and no reading counts on that screen; keep today's ending for adventure and learning.
current: After the last page StoryReaderView stops narration and goes straight to StoryEndingLeaf: Ragi waving, 'Masal bitti!', reading counts and a 400 ms celebration, the same in every mode.
recommendation: Two required voices heard and both support (reader owns the target, privacy-safety pass with conditions). 5 of 5 bedtime books end quieter than their average; none of 21 books has a celebration after the story. A UX target cannot be an experiment, and the change is small, reversible and display-only (StoryEndingLeaf, gate story.mode == bedtime or clock). Evidence LOW, so adopt as guidance for the bedtime ending, not as a rule for other modes.
decision_note: Uyku bitişi sakin; rozet tek satır

fields: StoryEndingLeaf bedtime variant: gate = story.mode == .bedtime || MPBedtime clock; no spring/scale on Ragi (fade only); streak + new-word tiles hidden; fresh badge as one quiet line; İyi geceler primary
tests: new StoryEndingLeafBedtimeTests (gate logic as a pure helper: mode bedtime
adventure at night); existing StoryReaderModelTests unchanged

safety.notes: Display-only: earning/recording of reading, streak, star and badges unchanged in bedtime; new badges remain in Benim köşem, no compensating push or banner; no new analytics event, data field or log; no haptic/celebration on the bedtime leaf; one explicit bedtime trigger (story mode vs MPBedtime time window) chosen by the owner.
